purpose: Reviewed set-to-TCGCSV-group links for the batch finish certifier. Used only where the audit's PROMO_SETS and exact group name or code matches find no group or several. Each link pins the exact group name; a renamed or missing group stops the batch. A link only chooses which market inventory is compared: every certification gate still applies.

unlinked.reason: TCGplayer lists the Unown Collection inside 'EX Unseen Forces' (group 1398, shared with ex10) as 'Unown (A)' with number A/28. Linking needs a per-set product filter and a letter-number name rule, so it stays open.
TCGplayer files the five Futsal promos inside 'Miscellaneous Cards & Products'. A whole-group comparison would ledger thousands of foreign products; it needs a group-subset capture format.
The six Yellow A alternates are split across 'Alternate Art Promos' and their own set groups (for example Trainers' Mail 92a in XY - Roaring Skies), so no single group holds the set.
